How to play
6×6 board; each side owns elephant, camel, two cats and three rabbits. Orthogonal one-step moves; rabbits cannot step backward. A unit adjacent to stronger enemy and no friendly unit is frozen. Push or pull a weaker enemy costs two consecutive steps. Four marked traps capture any occupant lacking adjacent friendly support after each step. Up to four steps per turn; complete turn cannot repeat its starting position.
First rabbit to far rank wins; lose if own rabbits gone or no legal turn; simultaneous trap removals resolve before goal check. Repetition draw.
